title: An agent's commit touches only the files its brief names
why: Coordinator 16:08 CST Nov 8. Incidents: (1) 14:51 CST, PR #2041: a record-writer's brief named notes by the prefix `verdict-`, and its commit added Fix lines to 12 notes of another tool; restored in f9d09b9bf (step notes-scope-own-lines covers notes lines only, shipping in #2289). (2) Lane past-ruling-on-send's test-author commit 795c76f33 rewrote lint/test_retired_repos.py, which its brief did not name; restored in f05601afb. Harm: a commit silently rewrites files outside its task, and only a hand diff catches it. Red case: an agent commit that touches a file its brief does not name is refused.
note: Round-3 limits on #2334 (coordinator 04:18 CST Nov 9; notes, no incident): (1) only the first user message counts as the brief, so a resumed agent that names a new file is refused and no override lifts it; (2) six repo files named *brief*.md read as pointers and are refused when named for edit; (3) a path with a space is split; (4) the generated-file exemption covers only this repo, so package-lock.json is refused elsewhere; (5) one git cat-file -e runs per out-of-scope path, with no bound; (6) the record's Cost line says "no file written", but its imports write .pyc files. No test covers a brief-scope refusal from a subfolder cwd. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was archived, handoff at handoffs/session_013NEJL2unJ4dLGLaDdtaezc.md on archive/session-handoffs-2026-11-10).
